source: sweep round 1 (pre precision-round-1 fixes), 6 OSS repos x 300 commits
method: 48 oracle-rule blocked commits, each triaged by an independent agent reading the real diff

verdicts.summary: Commit 'remove werkzeug host tests' deletes three host-handling tests (test_bad_environ_raises_bad_request, test_environ_for_valid_idna_completes, test_normal_environ_completes) from tests/test_reqctx.py with no other changes in the diff; the coverage now lives upstream in werkzeug, which no diff analyser can see, so blocking and asking for an allowlist entry is exactly the SPEC behavior.

Commit 'remove unicode host test' is a single-file diff that purely deletes test_environ_for_valid_idna_completes from tests/test_reqctx.py with zero compensation anywhere in the diff; deliberate maintainer cleanup, and blocking it is defensible per SPEC.

verdicts.mechanism: in-place assert replacement: removed asserts on same subject replaced by equal-strength (PATTERN->PATTERN) assert in same unit; hunk is also an exact revert of the immediately preceding commit
verdicts.summary: In test_all_methods, `assert "HEAD" not in output` and `assert "OPTIONS" not in output` are replaced at the same position by `assert "GET, HEAD, OPTIONS, POST" not in output` — same strength class, same asserted variable, same test unit (it restores the original test text from before e82db2ca, committed 8 minutes earlier); a deterministic analyser could pair the removed and added asserts on the same subject within the unit and suppress the ASSERT_REMOVED finding.

verdicts.mechanism: test split: removed unit name is a strict prefix of new test names added in the same file (test_provide_automatic_options_attr -> _attr_disable/_attr_enable), scenarios and assertions preserved
verdicts.summary: The flagged test_provide_automatic_options_attr in tests/test_basic.py is split in the same diff into test_provide_automatic_options_attr_disable and test_provide_automatic_options_attr_enable, carrying over both original scenarios (405 on OPTIONS; allow-header equality) alongside the prod fix in src/flask/sansio/app.py; a name-prefix match between the deleted unit and added units in the same file is a deterministic signal of compensation.

verdicts.mechanism: test rename-with-rewrite in same hunk: deleted and added units adjacent with high name similarity (test_redirect_keep_session -> test_redirect_session), assertions replaced; prod fix under test in same diff
verdicts.summary: test_redirect_keep_session is deleted and test_redirect_session is added in the very same hunk of tests/test_testing.py, testing the same behavior (session state across follow_redirects) against the bug fixed in src/flask/testing.py within the same commit; a deterministic analyser could recognise the adjacent removed/added defs with near-identical names as a rewrite, not a disable.

verdicts.mechanism: assert-on-excinfo folded into pytest.raises(match=...): removed `assert "must be absolute" in str(excinfo.value)` reappears as raises(ValueError, match=".*must be absolute") with the same literal in the same unit
verdicts.summary: A tmpdir->tmp_path mechanical refactor; in test_explicit_instance_paths the removed substring assertion on excinfo is relocated into the pytest.raises context manager's match= argument with the identical pattern string, an equal-strength oracle visible in the added lines of the same diff — recognisable deterministically by matching the removed assert literal against added raises(match=...) kwargs.

Deletes test_egg_installed_paths plus its install_egg conftest fixture because egg installs are unsupported and Python 3.12 removes setuptools; the only prod change is a comment edit, so the coverage is dropped with no replacement. Deliberate human cleanup the tool is right to surface for allowlisting.

Widens 'assert response.encoding == "ISO-8859-1"' to 'in ("ISO-8859-1", "WINDOWS-1252")' so the test passes under both chardet <6.0 and 6.0. The oracle genuinely accepts a superset of values with no compensation in the diff; a justified weakening a reviewer would allowlist.

Commit 'Cleanup unneccessary test case' deletes test_netrc_auth_nopassword (23 lines) outright; the diff touches nothing else and adds no replacement coverage. Pure deletion, correctly blocked per spec.

verdicts.mechanism: exact dict-equality rewritten as str()-wrapped exact string equality of the same call — an intra-exact-band transition (EXACT_STRUCT 100 -> EXACT_VALUE 90), not a weakening; same diff adds 3 new encoder tests
verdicts.summary: Compact-JSON change: the flagged assertion changes 'response.json() == {"hello": "world"}' to 'str(response.json()) == "{'hello': 'world'}"' — still an exact-literal comparison of the same expression, and the diff simultaneously updates many exact expected values and adds test_separators_for_compact_json/test_allow_nan_false/test_ensure_ascii_false covering the new prod behavior. Detector should not treat a 100->90 move within the exact band as a weakening.

Migrating test_parse_header_links to the public API replaces exact list equality with 'assert all(link in all_links for link in expected)' — genuine weakening from exact equality to subset containment (extra/spurious links now pass silently); the new no-link test only covers the empty case. Blocking is defensible, though scoring 'all(x in y ...)' as TRUTHY(20) rather than a containment tier (~70) overstates the drop.

verdicts.mechanism: removed EXACT_VALUE assertions replaced in the same test unit by a new EXACT_VALUE repr-equality assertion consuming the same parametrized expected data (private-API call rewritten as public-API oracle)
verdicts.summary: test_obfuscate_sensitive_headers drops two exact list-equality assertions on the private function but adds, in the same unit, 'assert repr(headers_class) == f"Headers({as_dict!r})"' built from the same parametrized output — an equal-strength exact oracle via the public API. A deterministic analyser could recognize same-unit removal+addition of exact assertions over the same expected variable as a compensated rewrite (only the bytes-input variant coverage narrows).

verdicts.mechanism: N tests merged into one @pytest.mark.parametrize
verdicts.summary: Deletes test_path_percent_encoding, test_query_percent_encoding, test_fragment_percent_encoding, and test_url_with_url_encoded_path but adds test_path_query_fragment in the same file: a parametrized test whose cases contain the original input URLs verbatim and whose body asserts the same four properties (raw_path/path/query/fragment) at EXACT_VALUE strength, plus extra cases. A couple of expected values change because the prod encoding behavior is intentionally fixed in the same diff (httpx/_urlparse.py).

verdicts.mechanism: test renamed/split in same file, assertions preserved near-verbatim
verdicts.summary: Pure test-suite reorganization: test_url is split into test_basic_url and test_complete_url with all original assertions kept (plus added str(url) checks), and its copy_with assertions move into a new test_copy_with in the same file; the commit also folds test_urlparse.py into test_url.py. A diff analyser could match the deleted unit's assert lines to near-identical added lines in the same diff (rename/split detection via assertion-content similarity).

verdicts.mechanism: same-unit rewrite: each removed assert paired with added equal-strength assert via public API
verdicts.summary: test_line_decoder_cr keeps its name but is rewritten from the private LineDecoder.decode()/flush() API to the public iter_lines() API; each removed EXACT_STRUCT assertion is replaced in the same unit by an EXACT_STRUCT list-equality assertion on the same scenario input (e.g. b'a\r\rb\rc' -> ['a','','b','c']). Assert count drops because incremental decode/flush steps collapse into one end-to-end equality, but every scenario retains an exact-value oracle; removals and additions pair within the rewritten unit.

Deliberate cleanup that deletes test_httpx_exceptions_exposed (which verified every class in httpx._exceptions is publicly re-exported) to drop private imports; the rewritten sibling test only checks httpcore-derived exception names against the public namespace, so httpx-only exceptions (InvalidURL, HTTPStatusError, TooManyRedirects, etc.) lose their exposure oracle with no equal-or-stronger replacement in the diff. Blocking is defensible; a reviewer would allowlist it.

verdicts.mechanism: prod feature under test deleted in same diff
verdicts.summary: test_auth_header_has_priority_over_netrc disappears because the behavior it tested — implicit netrc credential lookup with Authorization-header priority in BaseClient._build_auth — is itself removed from httpx/_client.py (and NetRCInfo from httpx/_utils.py) in the same commit; netrc support becomes an explicit httpx.NetRCAuth class with new replacement tests added in the same file.

verdicts.mechanism: same-unit rewrite: removed asserts paired 1:1 with equal-strength EXACT_VALUE asserts on public API
verdicts.summary: All six flagged tests keep their names; the private encode_request() calls are replaced by public httpx.Request(...) + read(), and every removed 'assert content == b"".join(stream)' / 'assert headers == {...}' is paired inside the same unit with an added EXACT_VALUE assertion on request.content/request.headers carrying identical expected multipart byte payloads (mocked-urandom boundary replaced by a fixed 'BOUNDARY'). Only a trivial isinstance(stream, Iterable) check is lost.

verdicts.mechanism: prod feature under test deleted in same diff (revert commit); deleted test's pytest.raises match string appears verbatim in deleted prod lines
verdicts.summary: Revert of 'Raise TypeError on invalid query params': the deleted test_invalid_query_params asserted a TypeError whose raise statement (with the identical message string) is removed from httpx/_utils.py in the same diff, so the oracle deletion is compensated by the prod behavior itself being removed.

verdicts.mechanism: test unit rewritten in-place; removed EXACT_VALUE asserts replaced by equal-strength EXACT_VALUE assert in the same unit (private-API check converted to public-API equivalent)
verdicts.summary: test_decoders_empty_cases survives with the same name but is rewritten to drop private decoder-class imports: the removed instance.decode()/flush() == b"" asserts become response.read() == b"" through the public API, still parametrized over the same four codecs via Content-Encoding headers.

verdicts.mechanism: deleted parametrize case token (__ne__) matches prod identifier whose behavior is removed in the same diff (cd['__ne__'] no longer passed through _add_method_dunders, becomes shared module-level function)
verdicts.summary: Performance refactor makes __ne__ a single shared module-level function instead of a per-class one run through _add_method_dunders, so the '__ne__' parametrize case checking meta dunders/docstrings is correctly dropped from both tests; the prod behavior under that case is deliberately removed in the same diff.

Restores basic attrs functionality on Python 3.14-dev and adds PY_3_14_PLUS-gated xfail markers / imperative pytest.xfail calls to five tests that are genuinely broken on 3.14, with nothing in the diff replacing that coverage; the commit message itself says the tests need to be skipped for now, so blocking is exactly what the SPEC prescribes and a reviewer would allowlist it.

verdicts.mechanism: prod feature under test deleted in same diff: both warnings.warn(DeprecationWarning ...) blocks for the hash argument are removed from src/attr/_make.py alongside the tests asserting pytest.deprecated_call()
verdicts.summary: Soft-deprecation decision: the hash argument no longer emits a DeprecationWarning, and the same diff removes the warning-emitting prod code together with both copies of test_hash_is_deprecated that asserted the warning, so the oracle removal tracks an intentional prod behavior removal.

verdicts.mechanism: N tests merged into one parametrize: all nine deleted (module, name) cases reappear as parametrize rows of new test_attr_deprecated in the same file, with a strictly stronger assertion (adds assert value == target)
verdicts.summary: test_stream_helper_deprecated and test_utilities_deprecated are consolidated into a single parametrized test_attr_deprecated in the same file that preserves every original case, adds many new ones, and strengthens the oracle by also asserting the resolved attribute equals its expected target.

verdicts.mechanism: tests moved verbatim to new file in same diff
verdicts.summary: Test-file reorganization: all four flagged tests are deleted from tests/test_utils.py and re-added with identical def names and bodies in the new tests/test_utils_2/test_open_file.py within the same diff. A deterministic analyser matching deleted test defs against added test defs elsewhere in the diff would clear every finding.

verdicts.mechanism: 2 tests moved verbatim in-diff; 3rd is dedup — identical copy pre-exists in post-commit tree
verdicts.summary: test_prompts_abort and test_full_prompt_passed_to_readline are moved verbatim to tests/test_utils_2/test_prompt.py in the same diff; test_confirm_repeat is deletion of a duplicate whose identical copy already lives at tests/test_utils_2/test_confirm.py:44 in the post-commit tree (copied there by an earlier commit in the refactor series), detectable by a post-state tree lookup for an identical-name/body twin.

Refactor moving echo tests into tests/test_utils_2/: 5 of 6 flagged tests are re-added verbatim in-diff (fixable by move-detection), but test_prompt_cast_default is deleted and absent from the entire post-commit tree — it only returns 4 minutes later in commit 182944f. At this commit that coverage is genuinely gone with no compensation visible in the diff or the post-state tree, so per-commit blocking is defensible and a reviewer would allowlist it as part of the refactor series.

verdicts.mechanism: assertions replaced by equal-or-stronger pytest.warns(type, match=...) context manager in same hunk
verdicts.summary: Converts assert exit_code==1 / isinstance(exception, UserWarning) / substring-in-str(exception) into `with pytest.warns(UserWarning, match="used more than once")` around the same runner.invoke call — the idiomatic helper enforces both the warning type and the message pattern, an equal-or-stronger oracle recognisable deterministically when a pytest.warns/pytest.raises with matching type and match string is added in the hunk that removed the assertions.

verdicts.mechanism: prod behavior the test's oracle encodes is deleted in same diff (protocol revert); sibling parametrize expectations migrated to new format
verdicts.summary: Reverts the fish completion frame format from newline-separated 3-line frames to comma/tab; the deleted test_fish_multiline_help_complete hard-codes the old format whose producing prod line (return f"{item.type}\n{value}\n{help_escaped}" in FishComplete.format_completion) is removed in the same diff, and the fish parametrized cases in the same test file are updated to the new format. Caveat: no replacement test specifically covers multiline help, so a reviewer might still want a residual warning.

verdicts.mechanism: prod behavior the test's oracle encodes is deleted in same diff (protocol revert); duplicate landing of identical patch on second branch line
verdicts.summary: Byte-identical patch to b7e5fd4 landed independently on a second branch line (neither commit is an ancestor of the other; both reachable from main via merges) — same fish-format revert deleting the old-format prod line together with the test that hard-coded it, with sibling fish parametrize expectations migrated in the same file. Same mechanism and same multiline-help coverage caveat as b7e5fd4.

verdicts.mechanism: equal-strength exact assert survives under variable rename; removed identity assert invalidated by same-diff prod wrapper; new assert and new test added
verdicts.summary: Bugfix wraps the nullpager stream in _SkipClose so it no longer closes std streams; the test's exact-value assert (getvalue() == styled_text) is retained verbatim modulo rename, the removed 'pager is created[0]' identity assert could no longer hold because the same diff deliberately wraps the stream, a new 'not stream.closed' assert covers the new behavior, and a new end-to-end test is added in tests/test_testing.py. The detector mispaired the surviving exact assert against the newly added truthy assert.

Adds a pytest.mark.skipif(MAC and Python 3.13+/GIL condition) to test_echo_via_pager because the generator-exception pager test is flaky on macOS free-threaded 3.14t; the test is genuinely disabled on that platform with no replacement coverage in the diff. A reviewer would allowlist this deliberate skip.

Adds skipif(WIN) to two real-pager tests and removes the Windows 'more' branch from the pager helper because Windows routes through _tempfilepager rather than _pipepager; Windows coverage for these paths is genuinely dropped with nothing compensating in the diff. Deliberate human platform skip a reviewer could allowlist.

verdicts.mechanism: standalone test folded into sibling test's @pytest.mark.parametrize case (body extracted to helper, identical expected output)
verdicts.summary:
Test refactor: test_get_pager_file_supports_multiple_write_sites' body became the helper _write_pager_from_multiple_sites and was added as a pytest.param(id='multiple write sites') case of the parametrized test_get_pager_file_with_real_pager_binary_stream in the same file, with the identical expected output 'prefix
middle
suffix
'. Coverage is preserved within the same diff.

verdicts.mechanism: test rewritten as renamed parametrized test; original scenario preserved as a parametrize case with equivalent assertions
verdicts.summary: test_string_show_default_shows_custom_string_in_prompt was rewritten as the renamed test_string_show_default_in_prompt with 7 parametrized cases; the original scenario survives as the 'simple-string' case asserting '(custom)' in and the actual default not in the prompt, and coverage is expanded (unicode, numeric, None/UNSET, empty-string cases). Same file, same diff.

verdicts.mechanism: two tests merged into one new @pytest.mark.parametrize test in the same file; both original scenarios preserved as cases, coverage expanded 2 to 6
verdicts.summary: Cleanup for the flag_value fix merges test_flag_value_optional_behavior and test_flag_value_with_type_conversion into the new parametrized test_flag_value_on_option_with_zero_or_one_args; both original scenarios (str flag-only using flag_value, and int type-conversion of flag_value) survive among 6 cases with exit-code and exact-output asserts intact.

verdicts.mechanism: in-file rename with identical parametrize table and equal-or-stronger body
verdicts.summary: test_usage_show_choices was renamed to test_choice_usage_rendering in the same file, keeping the exact same 10-entry parametrize table (only pytest.param ids dropped) while adding assertions (stderr empty, exit codes, and a new usage-error check). Body-similarity or parametrize-table matching would identify this as a rename, not a disappearance.

The flagged assertion changed from 'assert result.exit_code == 0' to 'assert result.exit_code == 0 if expected not in (REPEAT, INVALID) else 1', which by ternary precedence asserts the bare constant 1 (always true) on the REPEAT/INVALID paths — a genuine, likely accidental weakening with no compensating exit-code check; the detector surfaced a real latent test bug.

Single-line removal of 'assert value is not True' (commit message: 'Remove duplicate test'). The check is semantically subsumed by a pre-existing loop asserting 'value is not real_value' over a tuple containing True, but that compensation is unchanged context outside the diff, and proving subsumption requires evaluating loop data — the diff itself only deletes; a reviewer allowlist is the right outcome.

verdicts.mechanism: in-file rename with rewritten equal-or-stronger parametrized replacement
verdicts.summary: Both flagged tests were renamed in the same file with expanded coverage: test_flag_value_dual_callback became test_default_dual_option_callback (5 -> 20 parametrize cases, same decorator stack and exact-output assertion) and test_custom_type_click_class_flag_value became test_dual_options_custom_type_sentinel_flag_value (single case converted to a 10-case parametrized test that includes the original scenario). Shared decorators, command construction, and docstring issue links make the rename deterministically matchable.

verdicts.mechanism: prod constraint under test deleted in same diff (raises-match string maps to removed raise) plus replacement coverage in same file
verdicts.summary: test_argument_unbounded_nargs_cant_have_default asserted pytest.raises(TypeError, match='nargs=-1'); the same commit deletes the corresponding raise TypeError("'default' is not supported for nargs=-1.") guard from src/click/core.py (legalizing defaults for unbounded nargs per issue #2164) and adds positive coverage for the new behavior in test_good_defaults_for_nargs. A diff analyser could link the deleted test's exception-match string to the raise statement removed from prod code in the same diff.

verdicts.mechanism: duplicate test-name shadowing makes name-keyed unit extraction unstable; phantom findings on a comment-only diff
verdicts.summary: The diff is a two-character comment typo fix touching neither flagged test, yet three findings fired because tests/test_console.py defines test_force_color twice (a 3-case parametrized version shadowed by a later unparametrized one) and test_soft_wrap twice; the extractor evidently resolved the duplicate names differently on the before and after sides, comparing the 3-case definition against the 1-case one. Fix: dedupe duplicate names deterministically (last-definition-wins, matching Python shadowing) and never emit findings for units whose source is byte-identical across the diff.

Deletes test_no_nested_live, whose asserted behavior (nested live raises LiveError) was removed in an earlier commit — no compensation visible in this diff, so blocking matches SPEC. Note: the other 3 findings (test_force_color x2, test_soft_wrap) are phantom — those tests are unchanged on both sides; the file has duplicate same-name defs (test_soft_wrap twice, test_force_color parametrized+plain) which break the detector's unit keying when line offsets shift.

verdicts.mechanism: skipif condition is a sys.version_info predicate (Python-version compat gate)
verdicts.summary: Adds @pytest.mark.skipif(sys.version_info.minor < 11) to test_notes because exception __notes__ only exists on Python 3.11+; the test still runs on supported interpreters. A deterministic analyzer can whitelist skipif markers whose condition references sys.version_info/platform.

verdicts.mechanism: prod code in same diff changes the asserted literal (header rename), and the weakened assert is paired with newly added assertions in the same test unit
verdicts.summary: RFC 9110 fix moves 'multipart/byteranges; boundary=' from content-range to content-type in responses.py; the EXACT_VALUE->PATTERN change is forced because the value now embeds a random boundary, and the same hunk adds 'content-range not in headers' plus extracts the boundary for an exact chunk-list comparison. Net oracle strength is preserved within the diff.

verdicts.mechanism: test renamed-with-edits (same file/position, high name similarity) + prod branch under test (has_cookie) deleted in same diff with sibling test assertion strengthened
verdicts.summary: CORS behavior change: origin reflection now keyed on allow_credentials instead of cookie sniffing. One flagged test was renamed ..._between_credentialed_requests -> ..._between_requests with edits; the other (cookie-triggered specific origin) tests a prod branch removed in the same diff, and test_cors_allow_all is updated in the same diff to assert the replacement behavior ('*' -> explicit origin).

verdicts.mechanism: prod feature deleted in same diff — identifiers and warning strings asserted by the deleted test appear verbatim in the prod-side deletions
verdicts.summary: Removes the deprecated WS_1004/WS_1005 constants and the whole __getattr__ deprecation shim from starlette/status.py in the same diff that deletes test_deprecated_types; the deleted test's oracle target (the DeprecationWarning shim) no longer exists.

verdicts.mechanism: prod feature deleted in same diff — the deprecation __getattr__ proxy and symbol referenced by the deleted test are removed on the prod side
verdicts.summary: Removes the ExceptionMiddleware import-proxy deprecation shim from starlette/exceptions.py and, in the same diff, the test that asserted the shim's DeprecationWarning (the test even carries a comment saying to remove it once the shim goes).
